title: A Lamp for My Feet
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses to remember — and tonight a remembered scripture story is exactly what lit up the kind thing to do, the way the psalmist’s lamp lights the next step.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she treasures Heavenly Father’s words in her heart. In Wren’s world today: Wren couldn’t decide whether to tattle or be kind when her friend made a little mistake. Then she remembered a scripture story about being gentle, and it lit up the right thing to do — like a little lamp. She chose kindness. Just like the song-writer whose path was lit by Heavenly Father’s words, Wren found that the scriptures show us the way.
